text:
# listing.isFavourite

TL;DR:
- listing.isFavourite tells you whether the current actor saved this listing to favourites.

What it means:
- It is actor-relative and not a global signal.

Agent hint:
- Use it when the workflow is explicitly about saved or favourite listings.
